checksDetail: All five evidence actions honor read-only access
No source values, dates or verification are prefilled
Real controlled form sends verified values and dates; errors retain inputs, retry UUID and success refresh callback
Diabetes context defaults to unknown and can preserve unknown without fabricating lab values
Demo creation requires a button click, explicitly acknowledges synthetic data and selects a returned new patient
Unmount cancels the pending demo request and suppresses stale selection
engine: React 19 + jsdom 26; mocked API transport, real controlled components and request serialization
limitations: No native browser layout, modal focus trap, live Spring HTTP or live PostgreSQL verification
